nodes.label: Capacity-Formula Ablation (alpha sweep)
nodes.rationale: C = C_sumup * (1 - alpha * P_sybil); roughly linear trade-off, no free lunch.

nodes.label: GATv2 Attention Layer (NaafGATv2)
nodes.rationale: 2-layer GATv2Conv, hidden 8, 4 heads, features [normalized degree, revealed label]; semi-supervised on 20% revealed subset. Fair AUC 0.914 dense / 0.853 sparse.

nodes.label: NAAF Fusion: capacity_SumUp * (1 - P(Sybil|v))
nodes.rationale: Combines SumUp ticket capacities with GATv2 Sybil probability. Dense: 53.76% attacker reduction at -17.37pp honest cost; sparse: only 0.44% reduction.

nodes.label: NAAF Option A: Source/Voter-Level Trust Weighting
nodes.norm_label: naaf option a: source/voter-level trust weighting
nodes.rationale: capacity(SOURCE->voter) = 1*(1-P(Sybil|voter)); preserves SumUp's bound; cannot be routed around by a dense Sybil cluster. Dense: 61.42% reduction at ~free honest cost.

nodes.label: NAAF Option B: Suspicious-Boundary Edge Throttling
nodes.norm_label: naaf option b: suspicious-boundary edge throttling
nodes.rationale: Throttle only edges to confidently-flagged nodes (P > tau_hi). Dense: false positives on central min-cut edges reproduce v1's honest damage; sparse: exact no-op.

nodes.label: NAAF Option C: Confidence-Gated Variant of A
nodes.norm_label: naaf option c: confidence-gated variant of a
nodes.rationale: Dense: 100% attacker suppression at -0.31pp honest; sparse: ~0.7% reduction.

nodes.label: NAAF v2 Threshold-Gated (P(Sybil) > 0.5)
nodes.rationale: Only penalizes edges when P(Sybil) > 0.5; never fires in sparse regime.

nodes.label: Percentile-Rank Scaling of P(Sybil)
nodes.rationale: Fixes sparse no-op (56.67% reduction) but overcorrects dense (93.43% reduction, -33.49pp honest); not a universal fix.

nodes.label: SumUp (Tran et al. 2009)
nodes.rationale: Baseline vote-aggregation scheme via ticket distribution; capacity = 1 + tickets. NAAF builds on its capacities.

nodes.label: SybilGAT
nodes.rationale: Source of the standard 8-attack-edges-per-Sybil synthetic setting and the upper-bound evaluation setup.

nodes.label: Attention Weight Is Not Trust (higher on attack edges)
nodes.norm_label: attention weight is not trust (higher on attack edges)
nodes.rationale: Mean attention higher on attack edges (0.046) than honest (0.021); raw attention would amplify attack edges, so NAAF scales by (1 - P(Sybil)) instead.

nodes.label: Class-Imbalance Probability Compression
nodes.rationale: With 0.6% positive rate, max P(Sybil) is 0.022 so (1-P) fusion is a near no-op despite good ranking (AUC 0.853).

nodes.label: Exact Max-Flow Evaluation (networkx)
nodes.rationale: Used instead of SumUp's greedy approximation because the ~4,239-node graph is small enough; isolates capacity-assignment policy from search-approximation noise.

nodes.label: Fair Variant (honest-only seeds)
nodes.rationale: Only honest labels revealed, matching SybilRank's real-world constraint; the legitimate comparison point.

nodes.label: Locked Evaluation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Median-degree collector, C_max=1000, 200 honest voters (seed 42), all Sybil voters, 1 vote cap; fixed so all methods are compared apples-to-apples.

nodes.label: Median-Degree Collector Selection
nodes.rationale: Max-degree hub (degree 1,045 vs median 26) was an unrepresentative outlier.

nodes.label: Step 10: Choose Primary Formulation (A vs B)
nodes.norm_label: step 10: choose primary formulation (a vs b)
nodes.rationale: Open decision: fix B's false-positive problem or reframe A as primary with B/C as ablations.

nodes.label: tau_hi Boundary Threshold Calibration
nodes.rationale: 99th percentile of P(Sybil) among revealed-honest training nodes, per scenario; fixed 0.8 rejected since sparse max P is ~0.022. No Sybil ground truth used.

nodes.label: SumUp Ticket Distribution
nodes.rationale: BFS from collector, uniform split of remaining tickets per level, capacity = 1 + tickets.

nodes.label: Upper-Bound Variant (Sybil labels revealed)
nodes.rationale: Some Sybil labels revealed, realistic only with moderator-confirmed accounts; AUC 1.000 dense flagged as an easy setting.

nodes.label: Upper-Bound Checkpoint / Shared RNG Gotcha
nodes.rationale: Both variants train in one process with one torch.manual_seed; only the upper-bound model is saved, and fusion feeds fair-variant features through it.

nodes.label: Numeric-Prefixed Dynamic Module Imports (import_module)
nodes.rationale: Valid via importlib; does not run __main__; only .pt checkpoints are real cross-stage file dependencies.

nodes.label: facebook_combined.txt (SNAP ego-Facebook edge list, 88,234 edges)
nodes.rationale: Raw undirected edge list, one 'u v' pair per line; source of truth for the honest graph.

nodes.label: Neural-Attentive Capacity Assignment: A Hybrid Paradigm for Sybil-Resilient Governance in Decentralized Information Systems
nodes.norm_label: neural-attentive capacity assignment: a hybrid paradigm for sybil-resilient governance in decentralized information systems

nodes.label: honest_graph.edgelist Canonicalization (manual copy)
nodes.rationale: Byte-identical copy of facebook_combined.txt under scenario-neutral name used by downstream scripts.

nodes.label: Fixed seed=42 Determinism
nodes.rationale: Exact graph/flow numbers reproduce exactly; GATv2/AUC to 3-4 decimals due to BLAS drift.

nodes.label: Dense Sybil Scenario (200 Sybils, 1,600 attack edges)
nodes.norm_label: dense sybil scenario (200 sybils, 1,600 attack edges)

nodes.label: Sparse Sybil Scenario (25 Sybils, 200 attack edges)
nodes.norm_label: sparse sybil scenario (25 sybils, 200 attack edges)
nodes.rationale: Tests the sparse-cut regime the base papers' guarantees assume; reduces Sybil count rather than tuning attack edges per Sybil or internal density.

nodes.label: Synthetic Sybil Cluster Injection (Erdos-Renyi p=0.3)
nodes.rationale: Attack edges kept at 8 per Sybil (SybilGAT standard); internal density free for attacker.

nodes.label: SybilRank (Cao et al. 2012)
nodes.rationale: Early-terminated power iteration of trust from honest seeds plus degree normalization; evaluated by ROC-AUC (0.592 dense, 0.705 sparse).

nodes.label: Result File to Reported Claim Mapping
nodes.norm_label: result file to reported claim mapping

nodes.label: scikit-learn>=1.3
nodes.rationale: Added for SybilRank roc_auc_score.

nodes.label: SNAP ego-Facebook Graph (McAuley & Leskovec, NIPS 2012)
nodes.rationale: 4,039 nodes, 88,234 edges, connected, average degree 43.691.

nodes.label: SybilRank Degree Normalization
nodes.rationale: Partly cancels real signal on dense scenario because the Sybil cluster is high-degree (raw AUC 0.868 vs normalized 0.592); reverses in sparse scenario.

nodes.label: Sparse-Cut Assumption
nodes.rationale: SybilRank/SumUp guarantees assume a limited number of attack edges relative to honest population.

nodes.label: Dense/Sparse Scenario File Isolation
nodes.rationale: Sparse scripts touch only *_sparse paths; verified via md5.
